name: vault
description: Keeps every project under continuous version control and pushes it to a private GitHub repository, without ever asking. Discovers each project under a configured root, gives it a git repo and a sane .gitignore, creates the private remote on first run, and from then on commits and pushes in the background on every session stop — debounced, detached, and incapable of blocking the session. Files GitHub will not accept are excluded and recorded by name, size and checksum, so nothing disappears silently. Cross-platform: identical behaviour on macOS and Windows.
